items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: he said will you come over and work on Sunday's. I have a program.

ctx.x: The only one to take offense was Glenn,
-- I went from there over to KSDP, a guy by the name of Stan Hubbard used to come and hear me, and he knew I could -- he was crazy about the Lucky Strike dance

orchestra. And so he said will you come over and work on Sunday's. I have a program. By that time, Weflin, his home was in Minneapolis, and he was a drummer back at the station, the guy that was sobered up. And he was my biggest booster, so all I had to do was Sunday night, I'd go over and when they played these -- they played classical things, there was a director by the name of Hymie Wentler, who was the first flutist with the Minneapolis Symphony. But they'd play jazz tunes and when they'd do that, the first…
